title: Resolution urging Congress to ban housing bias against veterans
summary: This resolution calls on the United States Congress to pass S.2827/H.R.5443, which would amend the Fair Housing Act to prohibit housing discrimination based on veteran or military status and source of income. It cites the case of a Marine veteran who became homeless after landlords refused to accept his GI Bill housing benefits, and notes HUD found about 32,495 homeless veterans nationwide in 2025. It also notes New York City already bars such discrimination under Local Law 119 of 2017.
